name: Optimization Report 2026-05-30
body:
> Report · 2026-05-30

# Summary
Short Kim-format page optimization report for Saturday 5/30/26, organized by client into Findings, Fixes and Pending, plus a Google Ads section. It is the paste-ready companion to the longer [Local Page Optimization Report 2026-05-30](lib:brain-local-page-optimization-report-2026-05-30).

# Alphalete Trenchless
- Findings: 4 wrong-city metadata bugs, 84 templated meta descriptions, truncating titles and a brand typo, no FAQPage schema despite visible FAQ accordions.
- Fixes (live): 131 titles standardized; 84 metas rewritten with region tags; FAQPage layer built in mu-plugin v1.3.0; backups written, LiteSpeed purged, verified live.
- Pending: deploy v1.3.0 and populate per-page FAQs.

# Summit Plumbing Pros
- Findings: no city-specific FAQ/answer schema; mis-slugged and duplicate pages, broken links, title/H1 typos.
- Fixes (live): 110 pages emit Plumber + FAQPage schema with 7 city FAQs each and GEO detail; slugs fixed with auto-301s, broken links and title typos fixed.
- Pending: publish 8 draft pages; Chandler title/H1 fixes; pipe-lining phone-href and broken-link fixes (see [Broken Link Report 2026-05-29](lib:brain-broken-link-report-2026-05-29)); remaining service lines.

# Pipeliners
- Not yet audited or optimized; Search Atlas/Metasync auto-indexing plugin noted. Pending: apply the Summit/Alphalete model.

# Google Ads (all companies)
- Audited active campaigns for Alphalete, Summit and Pipeliners since the 5/25 check; pulled L1 (5/28), L7 (5/22 to 5/28) and L30 (4/29 to 5/28) windows; wrote plain-English interpretations and updated the Google Ads tracking sheet (a Google Sheet linked in the file).
- Read-only, no changes made. Some campaigns lacked L1/L7 data (paused or removed) and were flagged.
- Pending: apply recommended negatives and budget changes manually.
